identifiers.title: Identifiers
identifiers.description: Header tags emitted per file as identifiers, and whether the loader also matches Study Participants by person_source_value.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: DICOM tag keywords or "GGGG,EEEE" codes, e.g. ["PatientID"]. Default: none.

match_person_source_value.title: Match person_source_value
match_person_source_value.description: Let the loader match a Study Participant by these identifiers' values.

duplicate_handling.title: Duplicate handling
duplicate_handling.description: A file whose SOP Instance is already stored with different content: inherit the project's setting, skip (leave the file in the source) or update (replace the stored file). Default: inherit.
